latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Integrates OpenClaw with the Hermes Agent for self-improving AI capabilities.

- Connects OpenClaw to NousResearch Hermes Agent (53K stars), adding agent learning and multi-agent automation.
- Supports parallel sub-agent spawning, skill learning, and cross-session memory.
- Enables integration with 193 agency-agents expert roles across engineering, design, marketing, and more.
- Provides automation via built-in cron scheduling and supports multiple chat platforms including Telegram and Discord.
- Includes step-by-step installation, configuration guides, and usage examples for seamless setup.
